scope: Unmodified Gforth 0.7.3, whole-source EVALUATE harness to match input buffers. Portable values only; raw addresses and 64/32-bit boundaries excluded. On uncaught errors compare codes, not implementation-defined partial stack/output.

rows.name: binding
rows.source: : a 3 ; : b a ; : a 9 ; b a

rows.name: while
rows.source: : count 3 begin dup 0> while 1- repeat ; count

rows.name: nested do
rows.source: : indices 2 0 do 2 0 do j i loop loop ; indices

rows.name: leave
rows.source: : indices 9 0 do i dup 2 = if leave then loop ; indices

rows.name: exit
rows.source: : f dup 0= if drop 7 exit then 1+ ; 0 f 4 f

rows.name: unloop
rows.source: : f 5 0 do i dup 2 = if unloop exit then loop ; f

rows.name: recurse
rows.source: : f dup 2 < if drop 1 exit then dup 1- recurse * ; 5 f

rows.name: xt
rows.source: : f 4 ; ' f constant old : f 8 ; old execute f

rows.name: does
rows.source: : con create , does> @ ; 7 con a 9 con b a b

rows.name: body
rows.source: : con create , does> @ ; 4 con a 7 ' a >body ! a

rows.name: state
rows.source: : mode state @ ; immediate : compiled mode literal ; : interpreted [ mode ] literal ; compiled interpreted mode

rows.name: compiled print
rows.source: : hi ." Mixed CASE" cr ; hi hi

rows.name: counted string
rows.source: : data c" Case" ; data count type

rows.name: empty strings
rows.source: s" " dup . type s" " s" " compare

rows.name: parse name
rows.source: : read parse-name type ; read MiXeD read 世界

rows.name: nested eval
rows.source: : input s" 7 9 +" ; : second s" input evaluate" ; second evaluate

rows.name: parse immediate
rows.source: : size parse-name nip postpone literal ; immediate : x size MiXeD ; x

rows.name: unbalanced compile data stack rejected
rows.source: : text s" 4 5 +" ; immediate : x text evaluate ; x

rows.name: compare
rows.source: s" abc" s" abd" compare s" x" s" x" compare

rows.name: search
rows.source: s" abcdef" s" cd" search . type

rows.name: not found
rows.source: s" abc" s" z" search . type

rows.name: word
rows.source: : item 32 word count type ; item Hello item World

rows.name: two cell
rows.source: create x 2 cells allot 12 34 x 2! x 2@

rows.name: nested catch
rows.source: : x -77 throw ; : y ['] x catch -88 throw ; 4 ' y catch

rows.name: catch unknown
rows.source: : x s" missing" evaluate ; ' x catch

rows.name: catch loop
rows.source: : x 9 0 do i 3 = if -99 throw then loop ; 4 ' x catch

rows.name: catch eval
rows.source: : x s" -12 throw" evaluate ; ' x catch 6

rows.name: evaluate during compilation
rows.source: : text s" 4 5 +" evaluate ; immediate : x text ; x

rows.name: saved input
rows.source: : twice save-input parse-name type restore-input drop parse-name type ; twice AbC refill

rows.name: abort quote
rows.source: : checked abort" Bad value" 9 ; 0 checked 1 ' checked catch swap drop
rows.note: CATCH restores stack depth; overwritten cells are unspecified, so discard the flag cell before comparison.

rows.name: postponed quote
rows.source: : message postpone ." ; immediate : x message Hello CASE" ; x

rows.name: blank buffer
rows.source: create b 8 allot b 8 65 fill b 4 blank b 8 type

rows.name: byte copy
rows.source: create b 8 allot s" AbCdEfGh" b swap move b 8 type

rows.name: search repeated prefix
rows.source: s" aaaaab" s" aaab" search . type

rows.name: comment in string
rows.source: s" ( This \ is not a comment )" type
